name: canvas-mcp
description: Canvas LMS MCP server with FERPA-aware anonymization, account-admin tools, grading suite, and a TypeScript code-execution escape hatch.
long_description: Drop-in MCP server for Canvas LMS. Lists/creates Canvas content (courses, modules, pages, quizzes, assignments, rubrics), reads + grades submissions (single and bulk with dry-run + bounded concurrency), and exposes execute_typescript for token-efficient bulk operations against a curated code_api/. Every student-data path defaults to pseudonymized output (Student 1, Student 2, …) with a per-course persistent map on disk so longitudinal artifacts stay coherent. De-anonymization is gated by the operator — Claude cannot turn it off without an explicit env opt-in. Ships an optional Franklin School preset (9 TD Competencies) that other schools can swap by pointing SCHOOL_CONFIG at their own JSON file.

canvas_api_url.title: Canvas API URL
canvas_api_url.description: Base URL for your Canvas instance, e.g. https://franklin.instructure.com (do NOT include /api/v1).

canvas_api_token.title: Canvas API token
canvas_api_token.description: Generate from Canvas → Account → Settings → New Access Token. Required scopes depend on usage — full account access is needed for the account-scoped tools and grading writes. Stored locally; never sent anywhere except your Canvas host.

canvas_account_id.title: Canvas account id (optional, admin only)
canvas_account_id.description: Default account_id for list_account_courses / list_account_users. Use 'self' for the token-owner's account, or a numeric id. Leave blank if you don't have account-admin scope.

school_config.title: School config JSON (optional)
school_config.description: Path to a school preset. For Franklin School, set to ${__dirname}/configs/franklin.json. For another school, copy ${__dirname}/configs/example.json and edit. Leave blank to run with no competency framework.

anon_map_dir.title: Anonymization map directory (optional)
anon_map_dir.description: Where per-course pseudonym maps live. Defaults to ~/.canvas-mcp/anon-maps/. Point at a synced folder (iCloud Drive, Dropbox, NAS) to keep pseudonyms stable across machine loss — losing this directory orphans every Student N pseudonym referenced in past narratives, portfolios, and transition reports.

allow_deanonymize.title: Allow de-anonymized output (default OFF)
allow_deanonymize.description: When 'true', tools may return real student names when the caller passes anonymous: false. Otherwise the server forces anonymization even if requested. Set to 'true' only for explicit real-name workflows; flip back to blank or 'false' immediately after. Restart Claude Desktop after changing.

ts_sandbox_block_outbound.title: Block execute_typescript outbound network (default ON)
ts_sandbox_block_outbound.description: When 'true' (default), user code in execute_typescript can only reach hosts in the allowlist. Set to 'false' to disable the network guard — not recommended unless you understand the prompt-injection risk.

ts_sandbox_allowlist_hosts.title: execute_typescript host allowlist (optional)
ts_sandbox_allowlist_hosts.description: Comma-separated hostnames user code may reach. The Canvas host is automatically added when this is blank. Add others (e.g., 'api.openai.com,api.github.com') only if a workflow legitimately needs them.
